title: 19-BCV-002 - Alberta labeling for CSA A277 constructed homes

facts.text: The variance recognizes CSA A277 labels, without an accompanying Alberta Municipal Affairs label, as proof of conformance for factory-constructed and other off-site-constructed Part 9 homes.
The source describes independent certification-agency review of a constructor quality system and periodic audits.
It applies to a building listed under a CSA A277 manufacturer certification constructed on or after December 16, 2019; unfinished homes require permits for the work remaining on site.
